title: mikania hirsutissima var. martiana
intro: Mikania hirsutissima var. martiana, commonly known as Wild Passionflower or Passion Flower Vine, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae, native to Brazil. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide relief from anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness, due to its health benefits of promoting relaxation and reducing stress. The therapeutic actions of Mikania hirsutissima var. martiana include sedative and antispasmodic effects, which contribute to its use in treating muscle spasms and other nervous system disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, such as herniarin and martianin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
